name: fast-context
description: Intelligent codebase analysis engine for coding assistants with graph-powered code comprehension

scripts.build: cargo test --lib generate_typescript_types && node scripts/update-types.js && napi build --platform --release --features nodejs && node scripts/patch-win32-loader.js
scripts.build:debug: cargo test --lib generate_typescript_types && node scripts/update-types.js && napi build --platform --features nodejs && node scripts/patch-win32-loader.js
scripts.test:integration: cargo test --test api_integration_tests --test error_handling_tests --test graph_bindings_tests --test integration_tests --test nodejs_api_tests
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace=packages/cli
scripts.clean:packages: npm run clean --workspace=packages/core && npm run clean --workspace=packages/mcp-server && npm run clean --workspace=packages/cli
scripts.test:packages: npm run test --workspace=packages/core && npm run test --workspace=packages/mcp-server && npm run test --workspace=packages/cli
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build:packages && npm publish --workspace=packages/core && npm publish --workspace=packages/mcp-server && npm publish --workspace=packages/cli
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build:packages && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=packages/core && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=packages/mcp-server && npm publish --dry-run --workspace=packages/cli

author: Shawn McAllister x.com/entrepeneur4lyf
